summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Homeland Group project detail page bug fixes and new spec/feature fields. All requested features working correctly: (1) Hero video auto-play removed - static image used; (2) Logo left-aligned parallel to title; (3) Video accessible via thumbnail/lightbox; (4) New spec/feature fields added to Admin and render on public pages with auto-hide when empty.

design_issues.issue: Enquiry modal auto-opens on project detail page load, which can be intrusive and blocks initial interactions
design_issues.note: Not part of current bug fixes, but worth noting for future improvement
